features.title: Browse and filter the plugin catalog
features.summary: Search, filter by category and compatibility, sort, paginate, refresh, and open catalog entries without claiming unavailable detail or uninstall capabilities.

configuration.constraints: HTTPS only except loopback HTTP; no credentials, query, or fragment; normalize trailing slash.
Boolean; hide entries that fail compatibility checks.

failureModes: Catalog failures show a retry path without fabricating results.
Incompatible entries remain visible unless the user enables the filter.

externalDependencies.boundary: Hub catalog and exact plugin detail HTTP requests.
externalDependencies.deterministicFake: Route Hub list/detail requests to local fixtures; no registry or GitHub calls.

verification.testName: searches the Hub server-side after a debounce and sorts by stars
applies the configured default sort and hides incompatible plugins until toggled off
handles list failure, retry, empty categories and cursor pagination
forwards search and sort and exposes author, avatar, stars, update date and total

features.title: Install a selected plugin with explicit consent
features.summary: Require two explicit confirmations, re-fetch exact package detail, execute fixed argv, show install status, and explain restart guidance without hot-loading or restarting DSH.
failureModes: Package detail changes or ambiguity blocks installation.
CLI timeout, cancellation, profile activation failure, or package error remains visible and retryable.

externalDependencies.boundary: Fixed-argv DSH plugin install CLI and isolated profile activation.
externalDependencies.deterministicFake: Inject a fake CLI runner and temporary profile manifest; never invoke user profiles or package registries.

verification.testName: requires two confirmations with the fixed risk statement before every download
surfaces stable install errors and retries through the same confirmation path
installs a community plugin with the verified spec and verifies activation
rejects a zero exit when the bundle was not activated
